intended_object: Uniformity of a quotient of a polynomial functor (QPF): any two polynomial representatives ⟨a,f⟩, ⟨a',f'⟩ of the same value of F α (same image under abs) have contents with the same range. This is the notion from Avigad–Carneiro–Hudon; I inferred it from the docstring and the file's QPF theory.
explanation: The body says: for every type α, all shapes a, a' and all contents f, f', if abs ⟨a, f⟩ = abs ⟨a', f'⟩ then f '' univ = f' '' univ. This is exactly the standard uniformity condition for QPFs. It is stated for an arbitrary univariate QPF, which is its natural generality. MvQPF.IsUniform is a separate definition for multivariate QPFs, not a broader version of this one.
